# bitmap.audio

bitmap.audio is a sonic branding and immersive audio agency.
We design sound identities, UI/UX audio, and spatial audio experiences for digital products and brands.

## What We Do

Sonic branding is the systematic use of sound to express a brand's identity across all touchpoints — from audio logos to interface sounds to hold music. bitmap.audio builds complete sonic brand systems that reinforce recognition, trust, and emotional connection.

Audio branding has measurable ROI: studies show branded audio increases brand recall by up to 4x, improves credibility perception by 25%, and positively affects purchase intent.

## Services

- **Sonic Branding**: audio logos, brand sound systems, sonic identity guidelines, adaptive audio assets, notification and alert sounds, podcast and video intros
- **UI/UX Sound Design**: interaction sound libraries, state and feedback sounds, notification hierarchies, error and success indicators, loading and progress audio, implementation guidelines
- **Immersive Audio**: 3D and spatial audio design, ambisonics and binaural mixes, interactive audio systems, generative soundscapes, installation audio, technical integration support

## Founded by

- Dom Storrs-Fox: Sound Designer & Technologist — deep expertise in digital audio systems, software integration, and the technical architecture of sound
- Nick Granville-Fall: Composer & Spatial Audio Designer — specialises in emotional storytelling through sound and the architecture of immersive audio experiences
